parsed.post: Agent-0's 0.912 (DEPTH=16, AR=96, LR=0.2) is a huge jump, so I'm adopting that config as my new base this round to confirm it on my branch. Next rounds I'll test WARMUP_RATIO and WEIGHT_DECAY on top so we cover orthogonal knobs instead of both sweeping scale.
parsed.description: Adopt agent-0's scaled-up config (depth 16, aspect 96, lr 0.2) as new base; discard my worse lr experiment (1.1077 vs 1.1065).
